label: bidriware/people/copper-for-the-black
title: An artisan on copper and the black
description: A bidri artisan's words on the copper he adds to the zinc for the black of the finished ware, as reported by The News Minute.

u0002.text: For every kilogram of zinc, we use 60 gm of copper for it to get the perfect black hue.

u0004.text: As told to The News Minute

C080.text: One bidri artisan told The News Minute that 60 gm of copper goes into every kilogram of zinc to get the perfect black hue.

quotes.quote: For every kilogram of zinc, we use 60 gm of copper for it to get the perfect black hue.

S15.title: Exports hit, declining interest: Karnataka's Bidriware artisans struggle to earn a living
